# Document Merge and Dedupe 1.0.1

This corrective release aligns the plugin display name with the Obsidian
community directory naming rules.

## Changes

- Rename the display name from `Document Merge & Dedupe` to
  `Document Merge and Dedupe`.
- Keep the permanent plugin ID `document-merge-dedupe` unchanged.
- Include complete Simplified Chinese documentation.
- Rebuild all release assets from the corrected source commit.

No user data, settings, or merge behavior changes in this release.

---

- 显示名称由 `Document Merge & Dedupe` 改为
  `Document Merge and Dedupe`。
- 永久插件 ID `document-merge-dedupe` 保持不变。
- 增加完整的简体中文说明。
- 从修正后的同一个源码提交重新构建全部 Release 附件。

releases.description:
# Document Merge and Dedupe 1.0.0

Initial public release of an Obsidian desktop plugin for merging overlapping
Markdown clips and paginated documents.

## Highlights

- Supports ChatGPT, Gemini, repeated article clips, and common pagination URLs.
- Provides a searchable picker for manually selecting any Markdown documents.
- Removes exact duplicates and aligns overlapping paragraphs.
- Preserves Markdown structure, links, tables, code blocks, and attachment names.
- Generates a separate verification report for coverage, conflicts, and gaps.
- Preserves source files by default; optional cleanup uses recoverable trash.
- Processes all content locally with no network requests or telemetry.

---

## 中文说明

这是一个用于合并 Obsidian Markdown 分段剪藏、长对话和分页文章的桌面插件。

- 支持 ChatGPT、Gemini、同网址多次剪藏及常见分页网址。
- 提供可搜索的 Markdown 文档选择器。
- 自动识别完全重复内容并对齐重叠段落。
- 保留 Markdown 表格、代码块、链接和附件名称。
- 单独生成覆盖率、冲突和疑似缺口核验报告。
- 默认保留来源文件；可选清理使用可恢复的回收站。
- 全部内容只在本地处理，不发起网络请求，也不收集遥测数据。

完整中文说明请阅读 [README.zh-CN.md](https://github.com/JusEvi/document-merge-dedupe/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md)。
